title: Strongest project
text: Her strongest project is RentGuard, a live NYC apartment-safety app. Type any NYC address and it pulls that building's real HPD violations and 311 complaints, explains them in plain English, and answers questions only from those records, with citations. It declines legal conclusions and never calls a building safe. While testing, she found that a Jersey City address resolved to a Brooklyn building, because NYC's geocoder always returns its closest guess. She fixed it with a verification layer that checks house number, street, borough and ZIP, backed by 32 offline tests. Live demo: https://rentguard-fwpwhgu6y7iwhzbozcefml.streamlit.app/ Her other flagship is the AI Contact Enrichment Agent, which turns any B2B prospect into a research brief with outreach in about 45 seconds.

title: Projects overview
text: Her featured projects are RentGuard (NYC building-safety app, live) and the AI Contact Enrichment Agent, plus NextHire AI (job-search copilot), the AI Incident Response Agent (LangGraph and RAG), Audit Readiness AI (SOC 2 RAG assistant), Quantamind Legal AI (LoRA fine-tuning on CUAD), OpsPilot (full-stack agent SaaS) and the AI GTM Copilot. title: RentGuard
text: RentGuard is her NYC apartment-safety product. Type any NYC address and it pulls that building's live HPD violations and 311 complaints from NYC Open Data, explains them in plain English, and lets you ask questions answered only from that building's records, with citations. title: What sets her work apart
text: A consistent thread in her work is making AI systems trustworthy: grounding answers in source records, adding guardrails, and measuring quality with real evaluation. Examples include RentGuard's address verification and 32 offline tests, retrieval metrics on Audit Readiness AI, and the LoRA versus prompting comparison in Quantamind.

title: AI Contact Enrichment Agent
text: The AI Contact Enrichment Agent is a conversational agent that enriches any B2B prospect in about 45 seconds with live company intelligence, buying signals, ICP scoring and a personalized outreach draft. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, GPT-4o, Supabase and Vercel. Live demo: https://ai-enrichment-agent.vercel.app/ Code: https://github.com/aishwaryamy/ai-enrichment-agent

title: How she works
text: Her approach has four habits. 1) Find the real problem first: work out what decision the output feeds and where the data comes from. 2) Ground every answer in source records, with retrieval, citations and guardrails, so a system says it doesn't know instead of guessing (RentGuard, Audit Readiness AI). 3) Measure instead of assuming: compare approaches on a benchmark before choosing, for example Quantamind reached 92.5% with LoRA versus 85.3% with prompt engineering. 4) Break it, then ship it: hunt for edge cases, fix the failure and add a test, like the RentGuard address check that caught a Jersey City address resolving to a Brooklyn building.
